# sidecar.add_psf_weights_to_sidecar { #healpyxel.sidecar.add_psf_weights_to_sidecar }

```python
sidecar.add_psf_weights_to_sidecar(
    sidecar_df,
    src_geoms,
    cell_geoms,
    data_psf=None,
    cell_psf=None,
    combine_method='multiply',
    normalize=True,
)
```

Add a ``weight`` column to the sidecar DataFrame using PSF functions.

For each source-to-cell assignment, computes the weight by evaluating the
data PSF and cell PSF at the centroid-to-centroid offset, then combines
them using the specified method. Optionally normalizes weights per cell
so they sum to 1.0.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type             | Description                                                                     | Default      |
|----------------|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| sidecar_df     | pd.DataFrame     | DataFrame with at least ``source_id`` and ``healpix_id`` columns.               | _required_   |
| src_geoms      | sequence         | Source geometries indexed by ``source_id``.                                     | _required_   |
| cell_geoms     | dict or sequence | Mapping from ``healpix_id`` to cell geometry.                                   | _required_   |
| data_psf       | callable or None | Data Point Spread Function. Called as ``data_psf(dx, dy)``.                     | `None`       |
| cell_psf       | callable or None | Cell Point Spread Function. Called as ``cell_psf(dx, dy)``.                     | `None`       |
| combine_method | str              | How to combine PSF weights: ``'multiply'``, ``'sum'``, ``'min'``, or ``'max'``. | `'multiply'` |
| normalize      | bool             | If True, normalize weights per cell so they sum to 1.0.                         | `True`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                             |
|--------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | Copy of ``sidecar_df`` with an added ``weight`` column. |
